skills.name: My Name Is Megumin
skills.description: A Crimson Demon Clan member shows some pride. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Hit Rate +35% (7 sec) *Skill Use Rate +35%  (7 sec)

skills.name: Explosion Magic
skills.description: Hits enemies with very powerful magic. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 4500% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (3 sec)

abilities.name: Group: KONOSUBA
abilities.description: KONOSUBA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
